# Alertmanager

Plugin ID `alertmanager`. Alerts and silences.

The Alerts page lists the firing alerts with their labels and the silences that cover them, and
the alerts become attention items on the Overview. With the actions on, an administrator
silences an alert for a set time, and expires a silence dash created.

## What it shows

### Pages

| Page | Path |
|---|---|
| Alerts and silences | `/alerts` |

### Panels on other pages

| Page | Panel | Id |
|---|---|---|
| Overview, KPI row (`overview.kpis`) | Alerts firing | `alerts-firing` |

### Contributions

It contributes attention items and KPIs.

### Topics

Published on `/api/v1/stream` and `/api/v1/topics/{topic}`:

| Topic | Payload | What |
|---|---|---|
| `alertmanager.alerts` | `AlertsData` | Alerts and silences. |

## Dependencies

A change to a plugin's settings restarts it and the plugins that require or use it.

- **Uses** [Grafana](grafana.md) when it runs.

## Settings

Every setting is under `plugins.alertmanager` in the config file and is also in the [configuration reference](../configuration.md#pluginsalertmanager), with the rules for all of them: the layers, the `_FILE` form of each variable and secret references. _Restart_ marks a setting that applies only when dash restarts; a change to any other restarts the plugin in place.

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Restart | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins.alertmanager.type` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_TYPE` | string | - | no | no | The plugin type. dash runs one instance per type, so this is empty or the section name. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_ENABLED` | boolean | - | no | no | false turns the plugin off: its topics are removed, and the web UI drops its rail entry, palette entries, overview tiles and panels and shows a switched-off page at its address. Unset turns it on when it has the settings it needs (rustfs is off unless enabled: true, because nothing in its settings says an object store exists); a plugin without them is disabled ("not configured: set plugins.<id>.url", naming the setting to make) and the web UI hides its pages. true with settings missing or invalid makes it unconfigured, which hides its pages too. This is how prometheus, alertmanager, gatus, victorialogs, proxmox, hardware, kubernetes, flux, cnpg, rustfs, grafana, headlamp and launcher behave, and a change to any of their settings applies live: that plugin restarts, and so do the plugins that use or require it (a prometheus change restarts proxmox, hardware, kubernetes, cnpg and rustfs; a gatus change restarts hardware and kubernetes; a proxmox change restarts hardware; a kubernetes change restarts proxmox, flux and cnpg; a grafana change restarts alertmanager). |
| `plugins.alertmanager.url` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_URL` | string | - | no | no | Base URL of the service, e.g. http://host:9093. Empty turns the source off: dash makes no request and its panels show "source not configured". |
| `plugins.alertmanager.auth.basic.username` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_AUTH_BASIC_USERNAME` | string | - | no | no | User name. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.auth.basic.password` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_AUTH_BASIC_PASSWORD` | string | - | yes | no | Password: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Set together with username. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.auth.bearerToken` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_AUTH_BEARER_TOKEN` | string | - | yes | no | Bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer: a literal, env:NAME, file:/path or k8s:<namespace>/<name>#<key> (read from that Kubernetes Secret by the kubernetes plugin, which must run and be allowed to read it). Not together with basic. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.tls.caFile` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_TLS_CA_FILE` | string | - | no | no | Path of a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed the service's certificate, added to the system roots. Empty uses the system roots only. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.tls.insecureSkipVerify` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_TLS_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | boolean | - | no | no | Skip verifying the service's certificate and host name. Anyone on the network path can then impersonate the service: prefer caFile. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.ignoreAlerts` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_IGNORE_ALERTS` | list of strings (JSON) | `["Watchdog","InfoInhibitor"]` | no | no | Alert names dash drops everywhere: the alert list, the attention items and the firing count. A JSON list in the environment. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.severityMap` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_SEVERITY_MAP` | object (JSON) | `{"critical":"crit","warning":"warn"}` | no | no | How an alert's severity label value becomes dash's severity (crit or warn), as {label value: severity}. A JSON object in the environment. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.silenceDurations` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_SILENCE_DURATIONS` | list of strings (JSON) | `["1h","4h","24h","7d"]` | no | no | The silence lengths the dialog offers, from 1h, 4h, 24h and 7d. A JSON list in the environment. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.protectedAlerts` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_PROTECTED_ALERTS` | list of strings (JSON) | `["Watchdog"]` | no | no | Alert names nobody can silence through dash, whatever the role. A JSON list in the environment. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.actions.enabled` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_ACTIONS_ENABLED` | boolean | - | no | no | Offer the plugin's actions. Off by default: without it the actions are not mounted and the web UI does not show their buttons. |
| `plugins.alertmanager.actions.agents` | `DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_ACTIONS_AGENTS` | string | `approve` | no | no | What an AI agent's call of one of the plugin's action tools (MCP, a token with the mcp audience) does: deny hides the tools and refuses them, approve creates an approval request a person approves or denies in dash, allow runs the action at once. A target that needs its name typed (a protected namespace) always waits for a person's approval, even with allow. API tokens and signed-in people are never affected. The default is approve. A change applies without a restart of dash; it restarts the plugin's instance. |

An alert whose `severity` label value is not listed in `plugins.alertmanager.severityMap` is not
attention.

## Actions

### `silence.create`: Silence

`POST /api/v1/plugins/alertmanager/actions/silence.create`, for administrators. Not idempotent. Confirmation: none.

Input, a JSON object: `matchers` (array, required); `duration` (string, required, one of `1h`, `4h`, `24h`, `7d`); `comment` (string, required).

### `silence.expire`: Expire silence

`POST /api/v1/plugins/alertmanager/actions/silence.expire`, for administrators. Idempotent: repeating it with the same input is safe. Confirmation: none.

Input, a JSON object: `id` (string, required).

### Limits

- **Off by default.** The actions are mounted only while `plugins.alertmanager.actions.enabled` is `true` (`DASH_PLUGINS_ALERTMANAGER_ACTIONS_ENABLED`); until then their routes answer 404 and the web UI shows no button for them. A change restarts the plugin.
- **Administrators only.** A viewer gets 403 `forbidden`.
- **Rate limit.** One user may start 10 actions a minute, across every plugin's actions; more answer 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After`.
- **Strict input.** The body is JSON with only the fields above; a missing required field or a value outside its list answers 400 `invalid_input`.
- **Audited.** Each run is written to the audit log before it runs and again with its outcome; when that record cannot be written the action is refused (503 `audit_unavailable`). The 403 and 429 refusals above are recorded as denials, at most one per user (or, before sign-in, per peer) and reason a minute; a 404 or a 400 `invalid_input` is not.

- `silence.create` takes 1 to 20 `{name, value}` matchers, one of them `alertname`; `comment` is
  1 to 500 characters; `duration` is one of `silenceDurations`.
- A silence lasts one of `plugins.alertmanager.silenceDurations` (from `1h`, `4h`, `24h` and `7d`);
  every silence expires.
- Nobody can silence an alert named in `plugins.alertmanager.protectedAlerts` (default
  `Watchdog`), whatever the role: the Alerts page has no Silence button for it and
  `silence.create` answers 403.
- `silence.expire` expires only silences dash created (`createdBy` starting `dash:`).

## Demo twin

With `DASH_DEMO=true` dash runs the plugin's demo twin instead: the same manifest, enabled and configured whatever the settings say, publishing made-up data from the fake lab in `internal/demo/world` and contacting nothing. Its actions are mounted and change nothing outside dash.

Creating a silence mutes the alerts it matches and expiring it unmutes them, so the Alerts page
behaves as it would against a real Alertmanager.
